backup.scope: A password-protected backup of this installation: dogs, conversations, instructions, local files, and non-secret settings. Drafts and preferences from this browser are included.
backup.excluded: Saved account credentials and connections are not included. Reconnect your accounts on a new machine; existing credentials on the destination stay unchanged. External CLI sign-ins and remote VM disks are not included.
backup.privacy: Chats, drafts, and user files are not automatically redacted and may contain pasted secrets. Keep this backup private and save its password safely; it cannot be recovered.
backup.passwordHint: Use a password of at least 12 characters. You will need it to import this backup.
backup.importHint: Choose an encrypted .dogbackup file and validate it before changing anything. Backups support up to 10 GB of installation data. Older pack backups and shareable templates can still be imported from Templates.
backup.fromComputerHint: Copy this computer's dogs, chats and settings here straight from the desktop app: no file or password, and the upload continues where it stopped. This server restarts itself to finish.
backup.replaceWarning: This replaces everything in this installation; it does not merge. A recoverable safety backup of the current installation is kept before replacement. Restart is required.
backup.trustWarning: Only restore backups you trust: instructions, tricks, and dog permissions are restored too. Reconnect accounts as needed. Routines, webhooks, and calendar calls arrive paused; pending work is not resumed.
backup.restart: The backup is ready to restore. Fully quit later.dog and reopen it to finish. For a self-hosted server, restart the server process, then reload this browser. Do not just close this window.
backup.restartDesktop: Your backup is ready. Restart later.dog to finish restoring it. Closing this window will not restart the server.
backup.restartFailed: Could not restart later.dog. Fully quit the app and reopen it to finish restoring.
backup.recovering: Restoring this browser’s saved drafts and preferences…
